info.title: Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform.DevTools.Tool
info.description: CLI that runs a Chrome DevTools Protocol server whose browser is Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform: Playwright (connectOverCDP), Puppeteer and the other CDP clients connect to it as to a headless Chromium

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Run a Chrome DevTools Protocol server whose browser is Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform (as a headless Chromium 146.0.0.0)

options.name: --host
options.description: Address to listen on (use 0.0.0.0 to accept the remote clients) [default: 127.0.0.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on (0 chooses a free port) [default: 9222]

options.name: --allow-network
options.description: Let the pages load the documents and the resources of any URL (without it, the pages can only use the content they are given and the intercepted requests)

options.name: --system-fonts
options.description: Let the pages use the fonts installed on the machine

options.name: --max-connections
options.description: Maximum number of clients connected at the same time (the others wait)
